root_cause.text: The xhci debugfs code for reading PORTLI registers assumed every port up to xhci->max_ports would have a valid roothub pointer, but ports not covered by Supported Protocol capabilities (due to gaps or overcount) can have port->rhub set to NULL, leading to a NULL pointer dereference when accessing port->rhub->hcd.
root_cause.evidence: Commit message states "In such cases port->rhub will be NULL so we can't reach xhci behind it" and the patch adds an explicit NULL check for port->rhub before dereferencing it, printing the register value without accessing the roothub.

candidates.rationale: Retrieves the port pointer from sequence file private data; if port->rhub is NULL, later dereference in line 389 will crash.
Directly dereferences port->rhub->hcd without checking if port->rhub is NULL, causing NULL pointer dereference when port has no valid roothub.
Relies on port->port_reg being valid; while not the immediate rhub dereference, it is part of the same vulnerable code path that assumes full port initialization.
Accesses port->rhub for comparison, operating under the assumption it is non-NULL; if line 389 were not reached, this would still be unsafe if port->rhub were NULL.
Uses portli from the vulnerable read earlier; although not directly accessing rhub, it is part of the same debugfs function that is triggered by the NULL pointer dereference.
